NOTE
**Ready for review**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Precise before/after screenshots: the description now has three Before/After tables |
| ✅  | Self-review checklist restored to the PR template format |
| ✅  | Wrong top-left screenshot replaced, as the author reported |
| ✅  | Screenshots posted in the #design thread; Daniel K said "I think these look good!" and chose the text-only card |
| ℹ️  | One new push since the feedback (+8 lines), with the same single commit. Nobody asked for it, so a reviewer should check it. |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown. The author says checks pass, but the input has no check runs. |
| ℹ️  | Issue #39831 has no "help wanted" label, but a maintainer (emilysutherlin) assigned it to the author, so this is not a close case. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the feedback on this PR and has recently changed these files.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", assign @laurynmm, and consider dropping "design review" since the design is approved.

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this? The screenshots and checklist are fixed, and the text-only card design was approved in the #design thread.
```
